name: 1960s psychedelia

influenced_by: Art Nouveau's flowing linework (directly revived by poster artists)

media.title: Wes Wilson's Fillmore concert posters (1966–68)
media.note: pioneered the genre's warped, barely-legible lettering

media.title: The Beatles, Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band (1967) cover art

reacts_against: mainstream 1960s advertising's clean, legible design conventions, deliberately using vibrating, hard-to-read color combinations to evoke the visual distortion of a psychedelic drug experience.
revivals: periodic fashion revivals; a visible influence on 1990s rave flyer design

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Distorted visuals, themes of love, vibrant color palettes, surreal imagery, fluid shapes, organic forms, optical illusions, altered states of consciousness, experimental music techniques
wiki_facts.key_colors: Fluorescent colors, saturated hues, contrasting palettes, rainbow gradients
